description: This file defines the class FingerprintUiHelper, which manages the fingerprint authentication UI, including handling authentication callbacks, updating icons and error messages, and coordinating the fingerprint authentication process in an Android app.

classes.name: FingerprintUiHelper
classes.description: A helper class to manage fingerprint authentication UI, including starting/stopping listening for fingerprint input, handling authentication callbacks, and updating UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: isFingerprintAuthAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether the device hardware supports fingerprint authentication and whether fingerprints are enrolled.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Starts listening for fingerprint authentication with the provided CryptoObject.

methods.name: onAuthenticationHelp
methods.description: Provides help information during fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message and updates the UI to indicate an error state.
